base_member_text: [L10-L33] (MED/pointer-state) Every rank/type pointer in arraytype lacks default NULL initialization, so consumers cannot safely query association state on a newly created descriptor before the construction code explicitly initializes all unused alternatives.
audit_member_text: [L21-L31] (LOW/undefined pointer state) arraytype's mutually exclusive pointer components have no default NULL() initialization, so newly declared descriptors contain undefined association status for every component not explicitly set by generated mapping code.
[L37-L49] (MED/error-signaling contract) chartoindex reports an unknown name only by logging and returns -1 as an ordinary index, leaving callers able to subscript arrays with that invalid value.
